programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: The Great Escape: The team prepares to release two servals. But things go awry when one vanishes into Malawi's dangerous capital. Plus, a monkey arrives in a critical condition. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Brisbane Raid: Watch rescue officers Jo and Chantelle free a tangled-up ibis and vet Mel care for a baby koala that took a swan dive. (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: Nomads Of The Serengeti
programme.desc: Cradle of Mankind: Safari guide Jean Du Plessis heads to Mahale Mountains National Park to get up close and personal with Tanzania's wild chimpanzees. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Patrick Aryee's Wild World
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Monkeys: In Costa Rica, insect numbers are in decline. Patrick heads deep into the rainforest to find out just how far and wide this change is being felt. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: Great Addo Elephant: Elephants aren't the only stars of this South African park which is home to 'the big seven' - lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, rhino, whales and sharks. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: The Great Escape: The team prepares to release two servals. But things go awry when one vanishes into Malawi's dangerous capital. Plus, a monkey arrives in a critical condition. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Brisbane Raid: Watch rescue officers Jo and Chantelle free a tangled-up ibis and vet Mel care for a baby koala that took a swan dive. (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons
programme.desc: Winter: As plunging temperatures bring nature into winter, some animals flee south to find milder climes. But others are determined to tough out the brutal cold. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Kalahari: Land Of Secret Alliances
programme.desc: Join a group of scientists as they test a hypothesis: that animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the Kalahari's species. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Lion Daycare: Everyone helps with the upbringing of the little lion cubs in Kenya. Plus, a group of bees start a dance party. (5 of 6)

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Shark Dentist: A fish cleans a shark's pearly white teeth, two giraffes have a cuddle and a monkey shows off his toolbox. (6 of 6)

programme.title: Wild Tales From The Farm
programme.desc: Change in the Air: As the leaves change, wild urges grip the animals. Rams Roger and Hamish battle for dominance, while Sally the hen flies the coop. Also available in HDR. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Wild Tales From The Farm
programme.desc: Hunkering Down: The farm animals settle for the shortest days of the year. To stave off boredom, the cows enjoy holiday treats and a concert. Also available in HDR. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Villains: Admire the great white shark's electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Sidekicks: Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Three's a Crowd: Breeding season bites as Mick and Adele rescue a Jack Russel from a python. That's not all for Mick, he also corners a red-bellied black snake! (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Double Trouble: Gear up as Dan and Jess tackle mating eastern browns in a backyard. Hold your nerve when Mick finds a venomous snake in couch cushions. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: Qatar: Pearls In The Sand
programme.desc: Qatar: Pearls In The Sand: Explore a land of extremes. From Qatar's wild deserts to rare wildlife, see how human innovation reshapes a fragile landscape under climate threat. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Baboons: Rules Of The Troop
programme.desc: Follow four families of four different species to find out why baboons are among the most successful animals in Africa.

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Wombat
programme.desc: Wombat Wood: The humble wombat shares a common ancestor with the koala but is far less well known than its fellow Australian. But how do these elusive creatures live? (Ep 1 of 2)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Wombat
programme.desc: Joey's Journey: For wombats, the mating season is a break from their solitary lives. Despite their timidness, their behaviour here can be amazingly energetic. (Ep 2 of 2)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: Origin: Mark Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday week by joining him on his travels to the Galapagos as he charted the archipelago's rise from the ocean millions of years ago. (1 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: Adaptation: In celebration of his 100th birthday, join Sir David Attenborough as he discovered unique species, showing how life adapted to the islands' shifting landscapes. (2 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: Evolution: Celebrate Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday as he explored unusual Galapagos species, including giant tortoise Lonesome George. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Deadly Australians
programme.desc: Desert: Behind the facade of Australia's dramatic scenery lurks a motley crew of silent assassins, con artists, gang members and brutal brawlers. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Big Cat Country
programme.desc: Hollywoods Held Hostage: The Hollywood pride is in serious trouble! Having fled north to escape the Nomads, other lions move in and threaten to take over their territory. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Boss Shark
programme.desc: Boss Shark: Experts study over 100 great white sharks off New Zealand, testing speed, hunting and fearlessness to crown the alpha male in their mating race. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Boss Shark: Battle Of The Sexes
programme.desc: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, with shark specialist Dr Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: which sex reigns supreme?
